## Data Acquisition

```{r}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)

# Step 1: Find the game ID for "Super Mario 64"
game_search_url <- "https://www.speedrun.com/api/v1/games?name=Super%20Mario%2064"
game_response <- GET(game_search_url)
game_data <- fromJSON(content(game_response, as = "text"))

# Extract the correct game ID
game_name_options <- game_data$data$names$international
game_name <- "Super Mario 64"
index <- which(game_data$data$names$international == game_name)
game_id <- game_data$data$id[index]
cat("Game ID for ", game_name,": ", game_id, "\n", sep = "")

# Step 2: Get the categories for this game
categories_url <- paste0("https://www.speedrun.com/api/v1/games/", game_id, "/categories")
categories_response <- GET(categories_url)
categories_data <- fromJSON(content(categories_response, as = "text"))

# Find the correct category ID (16-Star)
category_name <- "16 Star"
category_id <- categories_data$data$id[which(categories_data$data$name == category_name)]
cat("Category ID for",category_name, category_id, "\n")

# Step 3: Fetch leaderboard data
if (length(category_id) > 0) {
  leaderboard_url <- paste0("https://www.speedrun.com/api/v1/leaderboards/", game_id, "/category/", category_id)
  
  leaderboard_response <- GET(leaderboard_url)
  leaderboard_data <- fromJSON(content(leaderboard_response, as = "text"))
  
  # Extract run times
  runs <- leaderboard_data$data$runs

  run_times <- data.frame(
    place = runs$place, 
    time_seconds = runs$run$times$primary_t)

  # Display first few rows
  print(head(run_times))
} else {
  cat("16-Star category not found.\n")
}

run_times %>% filter(time_seconds < 3000) %>% ggplot(aes(x = time_seconds)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 30)
```

```{r}
if(!file.exists("M64_16S.csv")) {
  run_times %>% 
    filter(time_seconds <= 3000) %>% 
    readr::write_csv("M64_16S.csv")
}
```
